title: Descent of principal boundary divisors
statement: Let k be contained in k prime, both algebraically closed fields [def-sc-field-extension], and let C be a smooth affine connected curve [def-sc-curves] with smooth proper connected compactification c [lem-sc-compactification]. Both compactifications are integral and Noetherian. For any germ-compatible restriction maps and boundary equivalence sending each point to the unique point above it, every boundary divisor [def-sc-divisor] of a unit on the base-changed affine curve belongs to the image of the boundary divisors of units on C under this equivalence. This asserts only reverse inclusion, without constructing the equivalence or proving order compatibility.

proof.text: Germ compatibility determines both canonical restriction maps on the nonempty image opens. A unit on C prime has zero order there, so extending its boundary divisor by zero is its full principal divisor D prime. Use e inverse to form D. Because he ties e to the unique rational fibres, flat pullback of point ideals (and their duals and products) identifies O(D) pullback with O(D prime). All points are rational, so the coefficient sum, hence degree, is preserved. Principal divisors have degree zero [lem-sc-deg-principal-zero]; their associated Picard class is trivial [lem-sc-divisor-class-curve].

Restrict the actual Picard pullback to the degree-zero Picard subgroups, using degree preservation. Its injectivity is exactly the first conclusion of [lem-sc-piczero-torsion-base-change] at n=1: the natural Jacobian comparison identifies it with extension of J points, and Spec k prime to Spec k is an epimorphism. Thus O(D) is trivial. By [lem-sc-divisor-class-curve] D is a principal divisor of a nonzero rational f. Its orders on C are zero, so the divisor exact sequence [lem-sc-divisor-sequence-general] gives a unit on C with this rational image. Germ compatibility then proves the required range membership. Empty and singleton boundaries reduce to the zero divisor.

theorem affine_boundary_unit_divisor_descent
    (k k' : Type u) [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] [Field k'] [IsAlgClosed k'] [Algebra k k']
    (C : Scheme.{u}) (f : C ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsConnectedCurve f] [Smooth f] [IsAffine C]
    (c : Compactification f) [IsConnectedCurve c.g] [Smooth c.g]
    [IsIntegral c.Z] [IsNoetherian c.Z]
    [IsIntegral (c.baseChange (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k')))).Z]
    [IsNoetherian (c.baseChange (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k')))).Z] 
    (φ : Γ(C, ⊤) →+* c.Z.functionField)
      (φ' : Γ(CategoryTheory.Limits.pullback f
          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k'))), ⊤) →+*
        (c.baseChange (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k')))).Z.functionField)
    (e : {P : closedPoints c.Z // P.val ∉ Set.range c.i.base} ≃
        {P : closedPoints (c.baseChange (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k')))).Z //
          P.val ∉
            Set.range (c.baseChange (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k')))).i.base})
    (hφ : (∀ (x : C) (s : Γ(C, ⊤)) (y : c.Z.presheaf.stalk (c.i.base x)),
        c.i.stalkMap x y = C.presheaf.germ ⊤ x trivial s →
          φ s = algebraMap (c.Z.presheaf.stalk (c.i.base x)) c.Z.functionField y) ∧
      (∀ (x : (CategoryTheory.Limits.pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k'))) :
          Scheme.{u}))
        (s : Γ(CategoryTheory.Limits.pullback f
          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k'))), ⊤))
        (y : (c.baseChange (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k')))).Z.presheaf.stalk
          ((c.baseChange (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k')))).i.base x)),
        (c.baseChange (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k')))).i.stalkMap x y =
            (CategoryTheory.Limits.pullback f
              (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k')))).presheaf.germ
              ⊤ x trivial s →
          φ' s = algebraMap
            ((c.baseChange (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k')))).Z.presheaf.stalk
              ((c.baseChange (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k')))).i.base x))
            (c.baseChange (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k')))).Z.functionField
            y))
    (he : (∀ P : {P : closedPoints c.Z // P.val ∉ Set.range c.i.base},
        (CategoryTheory.Limits.pullback.fst c.g
            (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k')))).base
            (e P).val.val = P.val.val ∧
          ∀ Q : (c.baseChange (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k')))).Z,
            (CategoryTheory.Limits.pullback.fst c.g
                (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k')))).base Q =
              P.val.val → Q = (e P).val.val)) :
    Set.range (fun u' : Γ(CategoryTheory.Limits.pullback f
            (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k'))), ⊤)ˣ ↦
          Finsupp.subtypeDomain
            (fun P : closedPoints (c.baseChange
                (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k')))).Z ↦
              P.val ∉
                Set.range (c.baseChange (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k')))).i.base)
            ((c.baseChange (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k')))).Z.div
              (Additive.ofMul (Units.map φ'.toMonoidHom u')))) ⊆
      Finsupp.domCongr e ''
          Set.range (fun u : Γ(C, ⊤)ˣ ↦
            Finsupp.subtypeDomain (fun P : closedPoints c.Z ↦ P.val ∉ Set.range c.i.base)
              (c.Z.div (Additive.ofMul (Units.map φ.toMonoidHom u))))
